title.narrative: IYCW-Meaningful Youth Engagement in Governance Structures of International Voluntary Service

description.narrative: The goal of this project is to contribute to meaningful youth engagement, to enhance the respect for their participation in decision-making and to shape an inclusive and safe environment for them to engage. To address youth issues and needs across the different regions, members of the ICYE Youth Engagement Committee and local volunteers will participate in an in-person training where they will acquire the competences to encourage and promote youth engagement in different contexts, to engage in intergenerational and intercultural dialogue and to build their global citizenship. The results of the workshop will include a strategic plan for the Youth Engagement Committee as well as the development of practices that can ensure intergenerational succession, gender equality and socially sustainable development.
